resultJson.title: Add Either manipulation sample
resultJson.body:
Adds `src/main/scala/either/EitherManipulation.scala`, a Scala 3 sample showing how to work with `Either`. It defines a `ParseError` enum and small parsing functions, then chains them with a for-comprehension. A `parseAll` function parses a list and stops at the first error. An `eitherDemo` main method shows `map`, `flatMap`, `left.map`, `fold`, `getOrElse`/`orElse`, pattern matching, `partitionMap`, `toRight` and `swap`.

The diff also includes `.orca/runs/de700ec9a940.progress.json`, an orca progress log. You may want to leave it out of the merge.
